svg.title: Enterprise Voice Agent Intra-Sentence Code-Switching & Multilingual Prosody Architecture (Stage 371 · P735–P736)
svg.desc: Visual comparison of legacy sentence-level static LID homophone gibberish vs P735 sub-word unified multilingual tokenizer (<=240ms frame LID + 10–16dB lexicon boost) and P736 unified multilingual TTS prosody/timbre continuity lock.
svg.text: STAGE 371 · TOPIC 11 · P735–P736
Intra-Sentence Code-Switching ASR & Multilingual TTS Prosody Continuity
句内中英粤混说与跨语种合成架构选型：子词级统一音素解码 (P735) 与多语种同音色 SSML 零爆音平滑切换 (P736)
① P735: Sub-Word Code-Switching Tokenizer & Frame LID (<=240ms)
⛔ Legacy Utterance-Level Static LID + Monolingual ASR
• Caller (HK/GBA VIP): "唔该帮我 check 下保单 HKD 5000 点样 claim 返？"
• Static LID locks zh-HK for whole sentence -> forces English words into Chinese chars:
• Corrupted Output: "唔该帮我 车卡 下保单 H K D 5000 点样 克林 返" -> RAG/Tool Miss!
Industry Baseline: >34% MER (Mixed Error Rate) spike on intra-sentence code-switching with static LID
✅ P735: Unified Multilingual BPE/Phoneme Decoder + Dynamic Lexicon
1. Frame-Level Language Posteriors (<=240ms): No whole-sentence language lock;
switches acoustic-phonetic states mid-sentence between zh-CN, zh-HK, and en-US
2. Shared Cross-Lingual Token Vocabulary: Decodes Hanzi + Latin subwords jointly
in a single beam search without forced homophone transliteration ("check", "claim")
3. Domain Code-Switch Phrase Boost (10–16 dB): Biases bilingual brand/SKU/medical
acronyms ("ICU", "MRI", "ETF", "eSIM", "LumaNest") against phonetic false friends
P735 Offline Policy Check: 0ms reported at nominal 1ms display resolution;
actual duration unresolved/not_measured; no sub-1ms upper bound established (synthetic)
② P736: Multilingual TTS Timbre Lock (>=0.94) & Boundary Crossfade
Multilingual Architecture Selection Matrix
• Option A: Pre-Call IVR / First-Turn LID Router + Monolingual Models — Lowest cost for pure single-lang
• Option B: Unified Multilingual Streaming ASR + DragonHD Multilingual TTS (P735+P736)
Best for HK/GBA/SG/Global CS: intra-sentence zh/yue/en switching + 100% verbatim compliance
• Option C: Native End-to-End Multilingual S2S (GPT-Live-1 / Gemini Live)
<310ms natural accent/language mirroring; pair with Cascaded lane for verbatim legal clauses
✅ P736: Zero-Jolt Multilingual Prosody & SSML <lang> Governance
• Unified Speaker Embedding across Locales: Single neural voice persona speaks
Mandarin, Cantonese, and English natively (timbreCosineSim >= 0.94, zero voice swap)
• Auto SSML <lang xml:lang="en-US"> + <phoneme> Injection: Prevents monolingual
TTS from spelling out English words letter-by-letter or with robotic syllable stress
• Boundary PCM Crossfade (<=15ms): Eliminates phase clicks between language spans
P736 Offline Policy Check: 0ms reported at nominal 1ms display resolution;
actual duration unresolved/not_measured; no sub-1ms upper bound established (synthetic)
PROVENANCE & MEASUREMENT BOUNDARY DISCLOSURE (STAGE 371 · DIMENSION 374)
• Offline Policy State Machine (P735/P736): 0ms reported at nominal 1ms display resolution; actual duration unresolved/not_measured; no sub-1ms upper bound established (synthetic).
• Live Acoustic Code-Switch ASR & Multilingual TTS Synthesis: Real-time beam-search decoding and neural vocoder latency are not_measured in local unit tests.
